name: Hub Template Migration
status: reference only -- run once per template change, never scheduled
description: A template shapes only the notes created AFTER it changed. When the Customer/Partner/Opportunity template renames or adds a section, the hubs already in the vault need this to match: Log renamed to History, captures notes split into a human Notes section and an agent Captured section, and sections put back in template order.

steps.name: Rename the children
steps.description: <Name>-log.md to <Name>-history.md, with its heading and index link.

steps.name: Structure the captures note
steps.description: ## Notes for the operator, ## Captured for agents -- the human_only / machine_write split made structural.

steps.name: Restore section order
steps.description: Backfilled sections are appended; each block is moved WITH its content into template order, unknown headings kept after the known ones.

notes: Idempotent: a second run reports zero changes.
A rename lands in three places: the template, every writer that builds the path or heading by hand, and this migration. Grep the catalog for the old name before calling it done.
